[Section] Experiments ::: Single system evaluation
[source_id=27] Table TABREF15 shows the results on the VLSP 2019 test set with two language models. Various language model weights were also used to find the optimal value for the test set. As we can see, the conversation language model with the weight of 8 yielded the best single system of 15.47% WER.
